herbsandharvest: 31 crops, 14 herbs, cheeses and Farmer's Delight cutting-board recipes for an early garden kitchen
Cooked sandwiches and pantry ingredients diversify Act II field provisions and Act V habitation supply
pamhc2foodcore: Prepared meals from familiar ingredients and reusable kitchen tools; no large extended-food expansion
A cooked chicken-dinner route to the ration bundle and ordinary food variety for the Ark habitat
pamhc2trees: Cultivated fruit orchard alongside the small native Herbs and Harvest tree set
Renewable fruit, nuts and spices for settled expedition outposts and Ark habitation
sushigocrafting: Optional sea-food preparation and a small recipe-discovery kitchen beside Aquaculture fishing
Coastal outpost cuisine; its food effects are optional and grant no campaign or Ark advantage
storagedelight: Functional drawers and cabinets for an ingredient pantry beside the existing cooking network
Optional inhabited Ark kitchen furniture; never a required construction ingredient

notes.source: Read-only CurseForge ATM10 instance metadata and licensed JAR metadata; all five installed files allow mod distribution. JARs remain outside this repository.
notes.dependencyClosure: Titanium 4.0.50 (project 287342) and Patchouli 93 (project 306770) required by Sushi Go Crafting's CurseForge relations are already pinned in catalog/curated.json. Farmer's Delight, Botany Pots, Aquaculture and the kitchen mods are already selected.
notes.worldgen: Nine overlapping Pam tree biome modifiers are overridden with neoforge:none; the already selected Farming for Blockheads Market sells each native sapling for one emerald, and eight native fruit plus any sapling can propagate it. All other Pam tree placements and Herbs/Sushi worldgen remain.
notes.fruitUse: Pam tree fruit contributes through c:fruits to Food Core fruit salad and fruit punch recipes, even without Food Extended.
notes.exclusions: Pam's Food Extended (887 recipe JSONs), Pam's Crops (96 extra crops overlapping the new garden), and Spice of Life: Carrot Edition (power reward for food variety) are outside this batch.
